panels.title: Krotność Polygon / Ethereum
panels.description: Ile razy Polygon wymaga więcej potwierdzeń blokowych niż Ethereum (przy porównywalnym czasie do finalności)

targets.query:
union(
  tables: [
    from(bucket: "metrics")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockchain_finalization")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confirmations_count")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r.blockchain == "Ethereum")
      |> mean()
      |> set(key: "blockchain", value: "Ethereum"),
    from(bucket: "metrics")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockchain_finalization")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confirmations_count")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r.blockchain == "Polygon")
      |> mean()
      |> set(key: "blockchain", value: "Polygon")
  ]
)
|> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["blockchain"], valueColumn: "_value")
|> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.Polygon / r.Ethereum, _time: r._start, _field: "ratio"}))
